title: Slow-cooker Honey Garlic Chicken
ingredients: 6 spring onions, trimmed and finely sliced
steps: Mix honey, tomato purée, soy sauce, rice vinegar and water in a small bowl. Stir in spring onions and garlic.
Pop chicken breasts into slow-cooker bowl; cover with sauce. Lid on.
Cook on high for 2–3 hours, or on low for 4–5 hours, stirring halfway through.
Shred chicken into the sauce using 2 forks.
Dry-fry sesame seeds for a couple of minutes until lightly toasted. Scatter over chicken with coriander.
notes: To cook in oven: place all ingredients in a lidded casserole; bake at 210°C/190°C fan for 45 minutes.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
